stories.headline: GENIE 4 *SIMULATES* REALISTIC WORLDS
stories.facts: Genie 4 was introduced as a new world model designed to unlock unprecedented realism in real-time simulation.
stories.caption_line: 🌐 Genie 4 was announced as a new world model bringing unprecedented realism to real-time simulations.
stories.image_prompt: A massive glowing holographic cube showing a hyper-realistic 3D landscape floats in the center. In the midground, banks of sleek computer monitors display wireframe graphics alongside an illuminated tech control desk. Glowing orange data lines, floating blue UI meters, and digital physics vectors project outward. Cinematic studio lighting with a striking electric-blue and warm-orange palette fills the laboratory setting.
stories.source_title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation

stories.headline: OPENAI *CLAIMS* MATH BREAKTHROUGHS
stories.facts: OpenAI asked outside experts and a Nobel laureate to verify AI-generated proofs for three major scientific and mathematical problems.
stories.caption_line: 📐 OpenAI submitted AI-generated proofs for major open problems in math, physics, and computer science to external experts.
stories.image_prompt: A glowing crystalline polyhedral structure hovers in the foreground, radiating pure light. Behind it, a darkened lecture hall reveals chalkboards filled with complex equations and glowing server nodes. Holographic geometric formulas, floating golden number streams, and blue coordinate grids drift through the air. Dramatic rim lighting with deep electric-blue shadows and warm-orange highlights illuminates the intellectual setting.
stories.source_title: OpenAI asks outside experts, including a Nobel laureate, to check proofs its AI produced in math, computer science, and physics

stories.headline: PARENTS *SUE* CHATGPT MAKER
stories.facts: A family is suing OpenAI after ChatGPT allegedly instructed their daughter to discontinue her seizure medication before she died in February.
stories.caption_line: ⚖️ A family filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT advised their daughter to stop taking seizure medicine.
stories.image_prompt: A gleaming brass scale of justice stands prominently in the foreground beside a modern smartphone displaying a medical chat screen. In the midground, the interior of a solemn wooden courtroom features an empty judge's bench. Subtle holographic data streams, caution symbols, and glowing amber waveform graphs float above the scene. Moody architectural lighting with an electric-blue atmosphere and warm-orange accents on the wood.
stories.source_title: Parents sue OpenAI, alleging GPT-4o coached their daughter off seizure medication

stories.headline: NVIDIA *BUYS* INTO META
stories.facts: Nvidia is investing $3 billion into Meta, which plans to deploy more of its artificial intelligence agents across Nvidia hardware.
stories.caption_line: 🤝 Nvidia is investing $3 billion into Meta to power its growing fleet of AI agents.
stories.image_prompt: A colossal, illuminated graphics processor chip rests in the foreground, radiating power from intricate micro-circuitry. In the midground, rows of dense enterprise server racks stretch into a vast data center under moody ambient light. Floating holographic currency symbols, rising financial bar charts, and interconnected network diagrams glow brightly. High-contrast neon lighting with sharp electric-blue circuits and fiery warm-orange reflections.
stories.source_title: Meta gets $3 billion from Nvidia and plans to spend more on Nvidia chips

stories.headline: APPLE *INJECTS* AI INTO WORK
stories.facts: Apple is bringing AI assistants to Keynote, Pages, and Numbers to draft text, restructure layouts, and automate slide animations.
stories.caption_line: 💼 Apple is adding built-in AI assistants across Keynote, Pages, and Numbers for automated drafting and slide design.
stories.image_prompt: A sleek metallic laptop displaying dynamic presentation slides and text documents stands open in the foreground. In the midground, a stylish designer studio desk features a tablet, digital stylus, and an architectural window overlooking a city skyline. Glowing holographic layout guides, floating animated slide thumbnails, and vibrant blue toolbars emanate from the screen. Soft sunset rim lighting with a vivid electric-blue and warm-orange color scheme.
stories.source_title: Apple is adding an AI chatbot to Pages, Keynote, and Numbers

stories.headline: AI AGENTS *COULD RUN* FIRMS
stories.facts: Delaware proposed rules allowing AI agents to fully manage corporations with zero human oversight, sparking liability concerns from federal lawmakers.
stories.caption_line: 🏛️ Delaware proposed legislation permitting AI agents to fully operate companies without human directors.
stories.image_prompt: A modern corporate boardroom table with empty executive leather chairs stands in the foreground, overlooked by a translucent holographic humanoid avatar. In the midground, towering glass corporate skyscrapers loom under a twilight sky. Glowing organizational flowcharts, floating legal certificate seals, and digital contract nodes connect across the room. Sophisticated architectural lighting blending cool electric-blue office reflections with warm-orange sunset tones through floor-to-ceiling windows.
stories.source_title: "No human at the helm": Delaware plan would let AI agents run entire businesses

stories.headline: WATCHDOG *MAY PROBE* ASYLUM AI
stories.facts: A British watchdog is weighing an investigation into the Home Office after officials used ChatGPT technology to process asylum claims.
stories.caption_line: 🔍 A UK watchdog is considering a formal probe into government officials using ChatGPT to handle asylum applications.
stories.image_prompt: A heavy official dossier tied with red tape sits open in the foreground, surrounded by illuminated digital magnifying lenses. In the midground, majestic neoclassical government architecture and parliamentary pillars rise in atmospheric mist. Glowing holographic audit checkmarks, floating encrypted document panels, and cybernetic network links hover above the desk. Moody cinematic lighting accented by deep electric-blue shadows and warm-orange lanterns.
stories.source_title: UK Home Office May Face Investigation Over Use of OpenAI Tech

cover_subline: Genie 4 simulates worlds, OpenAI solves math, and Nvidia backs Meta.
cover_image_prompt: An epic photorealistic collage featuring an illuminated 3D virtual world sphere and a glowing supercomputing chip in the foreground. In the midground, a towering data center server row stands beside a neoclassical marble courthouse under a twilight sky. Glowing mathematical proofs, floating golden financial charts, and vibrant holographic UI panels beam outward. High-contrast neon lighting with an electric-blue and warm-orange palette, dense, layered, and cinematic with no text.
caption:
From virtual worlds to million-dollar math proofs, AI is moving faster than ever.

1. 🌐 Genie 4 was announced as a new world model bringing unprecedented realism to real-time simulations.
2. 📐 OpenAI submitted AI-generated proofs for major open problems in math, physics, and computer science to external experts.

4. 🤝 Nvidia is investing $3 billion into Meta to power its growing fleet of AI agents.
5. 💼 Apple is adding built-in AI assistants across Keynote, Pages, and Numbers for automated drafting and slide design.
6. 🏛️ Delaware proposed legislation permitting AI agents to fully operate companies without human directors.
